name: bella-vista-trattoria

agent.name: Gia
agent.subtitle: Front desk · Bella Vista
agent.greeting: Buonasera, thanks for calling Bella Vista Trattoria. I'm Gia — would you like to book a table?

clientTools.name: check_availability
clientTools.description: Check table availability for a date, time, party size and area (patio or dining room). Call this before offering a table.

clientTools.name: book_table
clientTools.description: Book the reservation once the guest confirms the details. Call this to actually reserve the table.

capability: scheduling + booking modification + dietary note + SMS confirmation
intro: A real ElevenLabs agent, live on the restaurant's own site.
outro: Booked, resized, dietary-flagged, and confirmed — no host on the phone.

turns.caption: A guest asks for a patio table — the agent checks the floor in real time.
turns.user: Table for four this Saturday at 7 on the patio?

reply.say: Let me check the patio for Saturday at 7.
Good news — I can seat four on the patio Saturday at 7. Want me to lock it in?

do.text: Held: patio table for 4 · Sat 7:00 PM

turns.caption: Mid-conversation it resizes the party and logs a dietary note.
turns.user: Yes, but make it six people, and one is gluten-free.

reply.say: Updating your party to six and flagging a gluten-free guest for the kitchen.

reply.result: Party updated to 6, GF note routed to kitchen

reply.say: Done — six on the patio Saturday at 7, with the gluten-free note on the ticket.

turns.caption: Finally it confirms and fires off the text.
turns.user: Perfect. Can you text me the confirmation?

reply.say: Sending it now to the number on file.
Sent! You'll get a reminder the morning of. See you Saturday — buon appetito!
